It uses the free thermal strain only as an intermediate calculation step to determine the mechanical strain that must be induced to counteract it, not as the actual strain of the rod. The specification explicitly states 'Since length change is constrained to zero, the thermal stress σth will develop,' which correctly reflects the full restraint condition.
